title: Firewall applies leave Docker alone; DoT 853 persisted
objective: Any setup_wireguard_ssh.sh allow-* apply must replace only the inet filter table, never restart docker or its containers while docker's own rules are intact, and keep tcp/853 on wg0 (DoT) across every re-apply and reboot via a persisted ALLOW_DOT flag.
acceptance_criteria: Rendered ruleset has no 'flush ruleset' and declares-then-deletes inet filter before defining it (test_wg_firewall.sh)
restore_docker_rules restarts docker only when 'iptables -t nat -S DOCKER' fails (test_wg_firewall.sh)
ALLOW_DOT=true renders iifname wg0 tcp dport 853 accept; open_firewall goes through allow-dot (test_wg_firewall.sh, test_dot_resolver_install.sh)
vmbox: re-apply leaves docker, a probe container and a foreign nft table untouched; first-boot load works
Host: allow-dot applied with docker and gitea-caddy start times unchanged; verify reports no drift
out_of_scope: The publicly bound DoT branch's runtime rate-limited rule
Changing which ports are open beyond adding 853 on wg0
verifier: lib/tests/run_all.sh in shell_coverage_jail.sh, vmbox guest dotfw, setup_wireguard_ssh.sh verify on the host
